**Aleta is the next generation of family office software**
Aleta gives you full control over your consolidated picture of wealth. A beautifully designed interface lets you intuitively explore your wealth. And a future-ready, open architecture powered by an API, an MCP, and a Data Cube, gives you true freedom and flexibility to create custom reports, leverage AI, and connect seamlessly to other systems.
![](https://aleta.io/)![](https://aleta.io/)
Purpose-built family office software. Built from the ground up for family offices
Aleta is purpose-built family office software for managing complex, multi-asset, multi-entity wealth. Built over 15 years of wealth reporting expertise, Aleta consolidates every asset class including public equities, private equity, real estate, alternatives, and non-financial assets into a single intuitive picture of total wealth.
Unlike legacy enterprise platforms adapted for family office use, Aleta is architected around two non-negotiable requirements: the Principal must be able to see everything instantly through an intuitive interface, and the investment team must have deep investment reporting capabilities. Both are served by the same platform, the same data, and an open data layer built for the age of AI.
With over 15 years of wealth reporting expertise and more than $100 billion in assets on the platform, Aleta is recognized for the quality, accuracy, and depth of its data consolidation and reconciliation capabilities across global custodians and asset classes.
[Explore the Aleta Platform![button-icon](https://www.datocms-assets.com/81573/1677510349-arrow.svg)](https://aleta.io/what-we-do)
.
Total View of Wealth for the Principal
Most wealth platforms are built for finance professionals and handed to everyone else. Aleta is built the other way around. The Principal opens Aleta and sees the complete wealth picture without waiting for a report to be prepared or a spreadsheet to be updated.
The award-winning interface is clean, visual, and immediately intelligible on any device. Whether reviewing a portfolio on a phone or a next-generation family member seeing the family wealth for the first time, Aleta makes complex wealth feel simple.
.
Deep Investment Reporting
Whether it is the CIO tracking manager performance across a multi-asset portfolio, the CFO reconciling positions across entity structures, or an investment analyst building exposure reports for the investment committee, Aleta delivers deep investment reporting without the implementation overhead of legacy platforms.
Aleta turns raw data into actionable wealth intelligence. Time-weighted returns, IRR, MOIC, manager analytics, private market tracking, and custom reporting are available out of the box. Not as add-ons.
.
Open by design. Agent-ready.
Most investment reporting platforms are closed by design. Walled gardens. Aleta, on the other hand, is built on open architecture with open APIs and MCP, making it straightforward to connect the full Data Cube to your own AI infrastructure. Family offices are deploying AI agents directly on top of Aleta. Agents that monitor portfolios around the clock. Agents that draft investment committee reports. Agents that answer the Principal's questions in natural language.
The AI layer in wealth management is being built right now. It only works if the data foundation underneath it is ready. Aleta is that foundation.
Radically Simple. Seriously Powerful. Built for What's Next.

## Built For You.
###  .Single Family Offices
Aleta is purpose-built for single family offices managing complex wealth across multiple custodians, asset classes, entities, and geographies. Whether it’s a lean team of two or a dedicated investment staff of 20, Aleta scales to the mandate without scaling the complexity. Single family offices using Aleta gain a consolidated view of total wealth, automated data aggregation from global custodians, private market tracking, and a reporting layer that serves both the Principal and the investment team from the same platform.
###  .Principals & Wealth Owners
The Principal deserves to see their wealth clearly, without depending on a team member to prepare a report. Aleta gives principals direct, real-time access to their complete financial picture across all custodians, entities, currencies, and asset classes through an interface designed for clarity, not complexity. Aleta is trusted by some of the world's most demanding wealth owners precisely because it makes complexity invisible.
###  .Investment Teams, CIOs, & Advisors
For the CIO, CFO, investment analyst, or external advisor who needs more than a dashboard, Aleta provides the reporting depth that complex portfolios require. Manager analytics, IRR and MOIC tracking, exposure analysis, private equity reporting, and custom investment committee reports are all available without manual data preparation or specialist configuration.
###  .Next-Generation Family Members
Aleta is built for family members who expect software to be intuitive, mobile-first, and immediate. They gain secure access to the family's complete wealth picture through an interface that requires no training. Aleta makes wealth visible and intelligible to everyone who has a stake in it.
## Bridging Generations.
Aleta delivers a seamless experience for every family member.
Wealth reporting that speaks to every generation
Aleta unites the mindset of wealth creators with the digital-first expectations of tomorrow’s stewards. From curated reports to sleek, on-demand insights, Aleta delivers a seamless experience for every generation.
A best-in-class mobile experience
Aleta’s award-winning mobile app keeps both family office professionals and principals connected to real-time portfolio insights anytime. With a zero learning-curve interface, flexible navigation, and optional full white-labeling, the app delivers the seamless and intuitive experience that today’s wealth owners expect.
Tomorrow’s technology for today’s wealth
Aleta is crafted for the most forward-thinking family offices that expect more from their tech. Mobile-native, beautifully designed, powered by AI, and with an open architecture, Aleta is ready for the future of wealth reporting. Our API, MCP, and Data Cube enable a secure data flow between Aleta and other systems. Total freedom. Endless possibilities.

**What makes Aleta different from other family office software platforms**
**Open architecture vs. walled gardens**
Most family office platforms lock wealth data inside their ecosystem. Aleta's open API and MCP architecture means wealth data flows freely to every tool the family office uses: BI platforms, tax systems, GL systems, and AI infrastructure. This is not a feature. It is a design philosophy that determines whether a platform can serve the way family offices operate today and the way they will operate tomorrow.
**Principal-first design vs. finance-first design**
Most platforms are built for investment professionals and then handed to the Principal. Aleta is built for the Principal first, with the full reporting depth investment teams require sitting underneath the same interface. Award-winning design is not a cosmetic choice. It determines whether the person who owns the wealth actually uses the platform.
**Investment reporting vs. accounting overhead**
Aleta delivers deep investment reporting without the accounting overhead and implementation complexity of traditional platforms. Where legacy systems require complex implementations and dedicated accounting staff to generate investment reports, Aleta delivers the same depth out of the box, faster to implement, easier to operate, and designed for the way family offices actually work.
**AI-ready data foundation vs. static reporting**
Aleta's Data Cube provides clean, structured, reconciled data at the API layer, making it the natural foundation for AI agents in wealth management. Platforms built on closed architectures cannot support the agentic workflows that forward-thinking family offices are deploying today. Aleta was designed for this transition from the beginning.
**Award-winning recognition**
Aleta won Best Data Provider at the Family Wealth Report Awards 2026, the leading industry recognition for excellence in family wealth technology. This award recognizes the depth, accuracy, and reliability of Aleta's data consolidation capabilities across global custodians and asset classes. Aleta also won Best Consolidated Reporting at the WealthBriefing Awards 2026 due to its superior data aggregation, intuitive design, and flexible, real-time analytics.
**Simplicity as a strategic choice, not a compromise**
The largest and most sophisticated family offices in the world will not prompt-engineer their wealth view or sit through software training. They want it to work. Aleta's simplicity is not a concession to less demanding clients. It is a deliberate architectural choice that serves every client better. The same platform that gives a family member instant access to their first portfolio view gives a seasoned CIO full reporting depth. Simplicity and power are not opposites. At Aleta, they are the same thing.
**Pricing that does not penalize growth**
Aleta's pricing model is not based on assets under management. Family offices should not be penalized for growing their wealth. Aleta charges based on the scope of the platform, not the size of the portfolio.

## FAQ: About Aleta
### What is Aleta?
Aleta is purpose-built family office software. It delivers an intuitive, verified picture of total wealth for the Principal, deep investment reporting for the CIO, CFO, and investment team, and an open data layer built for the age of AI.
### Who is Aleta built for?
Aleta is built for single family offices managing complex, multi-asset, multi-entity wealth. It serves the Principal who needs immediate clarity about total wealth, the investment team that requires serious reporting depth, and forward-thinking families who want a platform ready for AI-driven operations.
### How long has Aleta been in the market?
Aleta is built on over 15 years of wealth reporting expertise. The platform currently has more than $100 billion in assets on the platform and processes over one million transactions annually.
### Has Aleta won any industry awards?
Yes. Aleta won Best Data Provider at the Family Wealth Report Awards 2026, one of the most respected industry recognitions in the family wealth technology sector. This award recognizes the quality, accuracy, and depth of Aleta's data consolidation and reconciliation capabilities. Aleta has also won Best Consolidated Reporting at the Wealth Briefing Awards 2026 and Best Reporting Solution at the Wealth For Good Awards 2024.
## FAQ Platform and Features
### What asset classes does Aleta support?
Aleta consolidates all asset classes into a single view, including public equities, fixed income, private equity, venture capital, real estate, alternatives, hedge funds, and non-financial assets such as art, collectibles, and other passion assets. All asset classes are reconciled into a single consolidated view of total wealth.
### What is Aleta Intelligence?
Aleta Intelligence is Aleta's wealth intelligence suite, a growing set of AI-powered tools built directly on the Data Cube. It starts with intelligent document processing: Aleta automatically reads, extracts, and reconciles data from private markets documents including capital calls, K-1s, and fund statements. Work that previously took hours of manual handling happens automatically. Aleta Intelligence is designed to expand as AI capabilities in wealth management mature.
### Does Aleta have an open API?
Yes. Aleta exposes the full Data Cube via open APIs, allowing family offices to connect their wealth data to any downstream system including PowerBI, Excel, Tableau, tax systems, GL systems, and custom AI infrastructure. Aleta also supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), making it straightforward to integrate with AI agents and language models.
### What is MCP and does Aleta support it?
MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard that enables AI agents and language models to connect directly to external data sources. Aleta supports MCP, which means family offices can deploy AI agents that query Aleta's Data Cube directly in natural language, enabling conversational wealth management experiences and automated reporting workflows.
### Does Aleta support private market investments?
Yes. Aleta has a dedicated private markets module that tracks valuations, capital calls, distributions, commitments, IRR, and MOIC for private equity, venture capital, real estate, and other illiquid investments. Private market data is fully integrated into the consolidated wealth view alongside liquid assets.
### How does Aleta handle multi-entity and multi-currency structures?
Aleta is built for the complexity of single family offices, which typically manage wealth across multiple legal entities, trusts, holding structures, and geographies. The platform consolidates all positions across entities and currencies into a single reconciled view, with full look-through capability to underlying assets.
### Is Aleta available on mobile?
Yes. Aleta has a best-in-class mobile app that gives principals and team members secure access to the complete wealth picture on any device. The mobile interface is designed with the same award-winning design principles as the desktop platform.
### What is the Data Cube?
The Aleta Data Cube is a structured, normalized, fully reconciled wealth data layer that sits at the core of the platform. It aggregates data from all custodians, asset classes, and entities, and exposes this data via open APIs and MCP for use in downstream systems, BI tools, and AI agents. The Data Cube is what makes Aleta an open, AI-ready platform rather than a closed reporting system.
### Does Aleta support white-labeling?
Yes. Aleta supports white-labeling, allowing wealth managers and multi-family offices to deliver the Aleta platform under their own brand identity.
### Is Aleta SOC 2 certified?
Yes. Aleta is SOC 2 Type II certified, meeting the highest standards for data security, availability, and confidentiality. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
## FAQ: Getting Started & Simplicity

Yes. Aleta is designed for single family offices of all sizes, from lean two-person teams to larger offices with dedicated investment staff. The platform scales to the mandate without scaling the complexity or the cost. You do not need a large team or significant technical resources to get full value from Aleta from day one.
### Can Aleta replace our Excel-based reporting?
Yes. Aleta is specifically designed to replace spreadsheet-based wealth reporting. Automated data feeds pull your positions daily from custodians and banks, reconciliation happens automatically, and reports are generated on demand. The manual work of downloading statements, copying data into Excel, and assembling reports is eliminated entirely.
### How difficult is it to get started with Aleta?
Getting started with Aleta is straightforward. Most single family offices are fully onboarded within weeks. The process involves connecting your custodian and bank data feeds, configuring your entity structure, and setting up user access. No specialist consultants, no complex data migrations, and no dedicated IT resources are required.

No. Aleta is designed to be used directly by family office teams without technical expertise. The interface is award-winning in its simplicity and requires no training for the Principal or family members. The investment team can configure reports and connect integrations without developer support.
### What if we only have one or two people managing the family office?
Aleta is ideal for lean family office teams. The platform automates the data aggregation, reconciliation, and reporting work that would otherwise consume a significant portion of a small team's time. A two-person office using Aleta has access to the same reporting depth as a much larger operation, without the manual overhead.
### How quickly can the Principal start seeing their wealth on Aleta?
In most implementations, the Principal has mobile access to their complete consolidated wealth picture within the first week. There is no waiting for a lengthy implementation before the core experience is live.
### Is Aleta easy to use for non-technical family members?
Yes. Aleta's interface is designed for principals and family members who want to understand their wealth without needing to understand finance software. The award-winning design ensures zero learning curve. Family members open the app and see their wealth clearly, immediately, with no training required.
